name: My Pet Kirche
source:
Main character enjoys an outdoor bath alone when Kirche suddenly intrudes. The border between reality and magic gets erased by her body.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角獨自享受露天浴池時，齊兒可突然闖了進來。現實與魔法的界限，被她的身體抹去。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
